plain_description.what: The test defines how to detect that a contestant model has changed since its cached answers were recorded, using 279 canary questions. Its first step checked whether one answer-extraction rule reproduces the cached answers for 12 models. It then tagged each model with the evaluation harness it came from.
plain_description.why: A leaderboard row may only carry a model's name if its answers still reflect that model and not artefacts of how they were extracted.
plain_description.information: It shows whether the cached answers can be trusted as a baseline for spotting model drift. Result: the preliminary steps are done. With one extractor, only 5 of 12 models reproduce. With each model's own harness rule, all 12 do, so the cached answers are harness artefacts and are now tagged by harness. The actual drift check needs new model generations and has not been run, so no model drift has been measured.
